scope: Four feature files only; no shared query-hook, authorization, command payload, version or idempotency changes.

checks: Current order version and commitment history reflect the completed command
Cutting detail and sibling progress refresh through shared invalidation
Quantity input resets after successful recording
Explicit user Refresh still adds a new detail read
Reconciliation counter updates and confirmation closes with the exact selected receipt

cleanup_of_callbacks: Removed only pure automatic refetch calls already covered by awaited active-scope invalidation. Preserved state resets, preview result handling, navigation callbacks, manual Refresh and Retry.
performance_limit: Removes a proven bounded redundant read; does not establish the cause of the intermittent hosted SQL timeout.
